correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the synchronous legal-force closure: it is monotone and has the same terminal hull as sequential forces. Exact independent integer/set implementation exhausted all 3473 subsets of sizes 0..5 (none force) and all 3003 size-six subsets (exactly 700 force). Separate Fano incidence construction verified all 28x28 noncollinear point/nonconcurrent line triples, with exactly 700 >=3-incidence cases matching forcing sets. Recomputed the 196/504 propagation split, five six-vertex induced-degree shapes (orbit sizes 28, 168, 168, 168, 168), the 336 GL(3,2)+polarity automorphisms, all 700 exchange neighborhoods and 700 BFSs. Exchange edges = 5712 and unordered distance counts (5712,34524,86184,87192,28056,2982), maximum 6. Finite exhaustive universe makes exact claims proven without extrapolation.
residual_risks: Only this 14-vertex graph and ordinary forcing rule; no inference for larger projective planes or nonminimum sets.

value.rationale: The Heawood incidence graph is the smallest projective-plane incidence network, and minimum zero forcing models canonical minimal infection/control seed locations. All minimum placements have a sharp geometric iff condition, and their symmetry, propagation-speed and exchange/reconfiguration invariants classify the whole natural optimizer family. The previously known value Z=6 alone neither implies nor trivializes these facts; finite exhaustive classification is appropriate for this distinguished finite graph.
residual_risks: Result concerns a single exceptional graph, not a general projective-plane theorem.
